scope: Read-only JSON/mesh/node/accessor inventory; no source assets or Unity scenes changed.
coordinateNotes: Bounds are glTF XYZ. The importer may convert handedness on Unity import.
Mesh local positions are commonly 100 times larger than the placed unit; preserve source node scale approximately 0.01 and rotation (often Rx90).
Discard display-scene translation, preserve or bake source rotation and scale, then recenter to the base.
Every package is a collection. All nodes are scene roots in these source files; similarly named empty nodes are not parents.
Representative oriented bounds include that instance rotation and scale, not an invariant canonical module orientation.
Bounds are projected accessor AABBs, not exact collider shapes; flat tops and holes require visual inspection.
LOD variants are distinct meshes; do not instantiate LOD0/1/2/3 all at once.
Adjacent empty name hints are inferred from adjacency and matching translation, not from a hierarchy relationship.
